## Research experience

### PhD Student
**University of Liverpool** · 2026–present

Investigating how multidrug-resistance plasmids alter bacterial behaviour and evolutionary dynamics in *P. aeruginosa*.

### MRes Research Project
**University of Liverpool** · 2025–2026  
**Supervisor:** Prof. Alistair Darby

Genomic and ecological differences in gut Clostridia, with a focus on *Clostridium perfringens*.

**Methods:** shotgun metagenomics · MAG recovery · diversity analysis · ANI · phylogenomics · HPC  
**Software:** Kraken2 · Bracken · MetaWRAP · MEGAHIT · CheckM · FastANI · dRep · R · Bash

### Undergraduate Dissertation
**University of Liverpool** · 2024–2025  
**Supervisor:** Dr Daniel Leybourne

Rhizobacteria-mediated changes to barley responses to *Sitobion avenae* and barley yellow dwarf virus.

**Methods:** bacterial culture · plant/aphid experiments · DAS-ELISA · mixed-effects modelling  
**Output:** Royal Entomological Society Student Forum 2025

### UNIQ+ Research Internship
**University of Oxford — Langdale Lab** · Summer 2024  
**Supervisor:** Dr Tina Schreier

Plasmodesmata distribution across the C3–C4 evolutionary gradient in *Flaveria*.

**Methods:** FIB-SEM · confocal microscopy · image segmentation · 3D reconstruction  
**Software:** Fiji · ImageJ · Amira · R · Plotly  
**Output:** Best Presentation Prize, Oxford Summer Research Symposium
